catalog.description: One-entry-per-template summary — what each bolt-on solves and when to recommend it instead of hand-building. Every template directory with a registry.json must have its README.md listed here (enforced by CI, see .github/workflows/validate-plugin-contract.yml).

sso-integration.description: Customer-facing contract for wiring edge-sso into an already-deployed origin: hosted login routes, /auth/providers and /auth/branding JSON contracts, login-page customization tiers, redirect validation, per-variant signing algorithm, the exact x-sso-* header set and anti-spoofing contract (from cdn-filter source — not documented anywhere in markdown), and the cookie-variant JWKS endpoint for verifying the session JWT.

totp-integration.description: Customer-facing contract for wiring edge-totp into an already-deployed origin: the three origin-side changes, Profile A/B trade-off, HANDOFF_KEY/JWKS shared config, enrollment, and the MFA_AUDIENCE claim the origin's Profile-B proof verification must check (from storage-and-secrets.md — not stated in context/integration.md itself).
